aka: Church of St Mary the Virgin and All Souls
Church of St. Mary the Virgin and All Souls, Bulwell

stories.text: Storms in 1843 damaged the old church of St Mary beyond repair, and a new one was built on its site in 1849–50 to the designs of Henry Isaac Stevens. It is listed Grade II.

210163.sum: The Church of St Mary the Virgin and All Souls, Bulwell is a parish church of the Church of England in Nottinghamshire, England. The church is Grade II listed by the Department for Culture, Media and Sport as it is a building of special architectural or historic interest.
